protocol.timed_region: Sequential fresh process through exit, including interpreter/JIT startup and complete output to regular file. Builds, tests, output hashing and comparison excluded.
protocol.selection: Audit every currently listed source for Python 3, Ruby, Perl, Lua, Node.js, PHP and Julia. Measure the minimum listed gz, local normalized gzip, and noncomment physical LOC; retain all ties. Compact-only cohort: no claim about fastest entry in these newly added languages.
protocol.source_metric: Language-aware comment removal (Pygments 2.19.2 for added languages; existing Julia scanner), whitespace collapse, UTF-8, gzip level 1, mtime=0. Local metric, not byte-identical to CLBG gz. Complete source; no reformatting.
protocol.endpoint_scope: New languages compact-only: no inference about fastest entries or zero-length tradeoff lines.
protocol.normalization: Each benchmark reruns an unchanged existing control; new elapsed times / new control median * preserved control comparison score. Original measurements remain unchanged.
protocol.compiler_load_guard: Before full invocations wait for no compiler with >=5% reported CPU. During timed samples inspect executable names every 10 seconds and at both boundaries; discard and retry samples overlapping detected compiler load. Inspection, output validation and retry bookkeeping are outside the timed region, except the lightweight periodic process snapshot.
